notes.title: Update Details (07/Aug/2019)
notes.content:
<Update>
[list]
[*]Anchors can now be launched at Titans from higher positions.
[*]Adjusted the attack strength of the player character and accompanying squad members during Titan transformation.
[*]In accordance with the attack strength adjustment during Titan transformation, the balance of the Warriors Stories "One on One" and "Fight to the Death" were adjusted.
[*]Corrected the effects of the skill "Back From The Brink". The number of effects will no longer be reset after changing equipment types during battle.
[*]Corrected the effects of the skills "Weapons Inspection" and "Fresh Start". The effects will now only be applied at a "Supply Base".
[*]Adjusted the effects of the skill "Elimination Bounty". The number of additional materials acquired when meeting the appropriate conditions has been changed from 20 to 1.
[*]For the Eden Mode of Territory Recovery Mode, the "SS clear rewards" for some strategic points were changed from "Scarlet Drop" to "Golden Drop".
[*]The number of "Wings of Freedom" needed to exchange for a "Golden Drop" from the Wings of Freedom Exchange NPC at the base in Another Mode was changed from 500 to 100.
[*]The reward for "Clear all the daily missions!" was changed from 1 "Golden Drop" to 5.
[*]When selecting an episode to deploy for in Another Mode, previously acquired evaluation ranks are now displayed.
[/list]


<Bug Fixes>
[list]
[*] Corrected an issue in which, after carrying over data from "Attack on Titan 2" to "Attack on Titan 2: Final Battle", a key could not be assigned for "Showdown Equipment".
[*] Corrected an issue in which the system for entering and converting Japanese text would sometimes cause the app to stop when attempting to enter and convert a name.
[*] Corrected an issue in which, after carrying over data from "Attack on Titan 2" to "Attack on Titan 2: Final Battle", the outfits of some characters were not unlocked for the Muster Roll of the Gallery.
[*] Corrected an issue in which dash attacks could not be performed during Titan transformation.
[*] Corrected an issue in which the effects of 1 of the 2 "Strength +10" skills that Kenny acquires were not applied.
[*] Corrected an issue in which, if the player died while equipped with firearms, their lock-on target sometimes became fixed to a location after retrying the game.
[*] Corrected an issue in which, when playing Another Mode online, if a player with a different language setting joined an ongoing battle, messages were displayed in the incorrect language.
[*] Corrected an issue in which, when playing Another Mode online, Daily Missions were sometimes not updated at the correct time.
[*] Corrected an issue in which, when playing Another Mode online, during specific times the content of the Daily Missions screen was displayed incorrectly.
[*] When playing Inferno Mode, the display of the difficulty setting on the Options screen has been changed from "Inferno" to "Nightmare".
[*] Corrected an issue in which, when setting controls from Options, the "Buddy Action" settings for firearms were not applied correctly.
[*] Corrected an issue in which, when attacking with Thunder Spears using the game-exclusive protagonist, the game-exclusive protagonist would sometimes not appear on the screen during the corresponding animation for such attacks.
[*] Corrected an issue in which, sometimes Mobile Items were unintendedly used immediately after entering the inputs for a Buddy Action.
[*] Corrected issues regarding the display of UI and controls.
[*] Corrected several other minor issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Details (10/Jul/2019)
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the game would crash under certain conditions when recovering territory in Territory Recovery Mode.

notes.title: Attack on Titan 2: Final Battle has been released!
notes.content:
Help take back the walls and win one for humanity as all of the action based on Seasons 1-3 of the worldwide phenomenon anime is now playable for the first time in this all-new excitement-laced experience.
Take on the Titans with an innovative and fresh array of weapons, including Thunder Spears and a Gatling Gun, not to mention Omni-Directional Mobility gear that will send you swinging from rooftops to slice enemies with your trusty blade.
But the action doesn’t stop there, as Territory Recover mode lets gamers select from over 40 playable characters to assemble their own dream team in hopes of defeating the Titans and reclaiming the map for humanity. 
Humanity or Titans? Which side will live? Which side will perish?  
The fate of the world lies in your hands. 

[h1]Early Bonus[/h1]
The following bonus will be downloadable for free until August 1, 2019:
the “Queen Historia” costume for Christa; “Young Male Coat” for Kenny; “Plain Clothes (Underground City)” for Levi; and the “One-piece Dress” costume for Mikasa.

notes.title: The Attack on Titan 2 Demo is now available!
notes.content:
Experience the thrill of using omni-directional action to battle against Titans in the Attack on Titan 2 Demo coming out on May 7.

For players new to the Attack on Titan 2 or the Attack on Titan series in general, it’s a great chance to try out the game’s exhilarating omni-directional action.

Players who clear the demo will be awarded 200 “Wings of Freedom” that can be carried over to the full game Attack on Titan 2: Final Battle, available on July 5, 2019.

Attack on Titan 2 Demo will be distributed during the limited period(till July 31, 2019).

notes.title: Update Details (09/08/2018)
notes.content:
- Kenny’s hat has been added to the player character’s available hairstyles.
- A new difficulty level of “Heaven” has been added to the options.
At this level of difficulty, an unlimited number of items can be carried in battle.
- Learnable player character skills have been added.
Once learned, these skills of the anime series characters become equippable after winning a battle.
- Functionality to choose the in-battle background music has been added to the selection screens for scout missions and past missions.
- Titan Elimination Training (Expulsion) and Titan Elimination Training (Showdown) modes have been added to the Titan Research Room.
- The completion reward for Titan Biological Research Report has been changed from Titan Research Room EXP to a Generic Statement of Deployment.
It’s now also possible to carry out a Titan Biological Research Report without using any Wings of Freedom.
- Multiple pieces of equipment can now be developed at once.
- Multiple selections of materials are now possible when reinforcing weapons. 
- Generic Statements of Deployment have been added to the regiment store.
They become eligible for purchase after winning a battle.
- It is now possible to skip certain camerawork during battle.

notes.title: Problem notice and how to prevent the issue（03/26/2018
notes.content:
When starting Inferno Mode, part of the game becomes unresponsive

When Inferno Mode is started after playing online, the player character may become unresponsive to controls. 

The following temporary measure can be used to resolve the issue:
1.　　Load the save data causing the issue
2.　　While offline, partake in a battle and save the game when you have returned to the Daily Life section.
3.　　Start Inferno Mode.

Note: select any of the following battles for step 2
 - While offline, any episode in Story Mode
 - While offline, any Scout Mission in Story Mode
 - While offline, any Scout Mission in Another Mode

notes.title: Update information for Steam version of "Attack on Titan 2" (2018/03/20)
notes.content:
With this update, the changes below have been made to the Steam version of "Attack on Titan 2".

① Support for Western languages
With this update, the game can now be played using the languages below.
By selecting a language from the launcher window after starting the game, you can play the game in the selected language.

 - English
 - French
 - Italian
 - German
 - Spanish (Spain)
 - Spanish (Latin America)

② Save data that was created while playing in Japanese/Asian languages can now be used after switching to American/European languages.

When switching between Japanese/Asian languages and American/European languages, you can now save and load save data that was created while playing in a different language.
Such data is applied concurrently with this update.

notes.title: Problem notice and how to prevent the issue（03/19/2018）
notes.content:
Preventing the following known issues:

We are currently confirming the issues below that occur in "Attack on Titan 2".

We are preparing a patch to handle these issues.
We apologize for any inconvenience that such issues might cause our customers, and kindly ask for your patience until corrective measures are applied.

In the meanwhile, until the patch has been applied, please refer to the instructions below for methods to prevent the issues.

◆Issue 1

If the following conditions are met during game play, the game cannot progress as usual:

 - In the Daily Life section after completing Chapter 2 - Episode 4 "Experiment" of the Story Mode, Annie is invited on a Scout Mission and is added as an ally.
 - In the same Daily Life section, the game is advanced to the point in which Annie joins the Military Police Regiment and leaves the Daily Life section.
 - In a state for which the two above conditions are met, before advancing to the Daily Life section after completing the battle in Chapter 3 Episode 5, any Scout Mission in Story Mode is completed.

To prevent the issue:
1. In the Daily Life section after completing Chapter 2 - Episode 4 "Experiment," do not have Annie join as an ally.
2. Alternatively, after Annie leaves the Daily Life section, add a character other than Annie or Erwin as an ally.

◆Issue 2

If the following conditions are met during game play, the game cannot progress as usual:

 - In the Daily Life section after completing Chapter 2 - Episode 4 "Experiment" of the Story Mode, Erwin is invited on a Scout Mission and is added as an ally.
 - In the same Daily Life section, the game is advanced to the point in which the event where it is decided which type of soldier the main character and their party are to become occurs, and Erwin leaves the Daily Life section.
 - In a state for which the two above conditions are met, before Erwin reappears in the same Daily Life section, any Scout Mission in Story Mode is completed.

To prevent the issue:
1. In the Daily Life section after completing Chapter 2 - Episode 4 "Experiment," do not have Erwin join as an ally.
2. Alternatively, after Erwin leaves the Daily Life section, add a character other than Annie or Erwin as an ally.

notes.title: Untitled
Notice concerning how to apply the corrections for the issues that occurred in the Steam version of "Attack on Titan 2".(03/16/2018)
notes.content:
An update has been implemented that corrects the issues below that occurred in the Steam version of "Attack on Titan 2".

We offer our sincere apologies for any inconveniences such issues might have caused our customers.

■(Corrected) Sometimes the creation of save data failed.

Corrected an issue in which creation of save data failed if characters other than one-byte alphanumeric characters were included in the path name of the folder to which save data was to be created.
Note that if the issue was avoided by moving the location of your Documents folder, we recommend that you return the location of the folder to its original location by following the procedure below.

1: Open "Explorer", right-click "Documents" under "PC", and then select "Properties".

2: Select the "Locations" tab.

3: Select the "Move" button.

4: Select the original location of your Documents folder, and then click the "Apply" button.

5: A window will appear confirming whether you want to move the folder. Select "Yes".

■(Corrected) Sometimes DLC was not applied within the game.
Corrected an issue in which the "Early Release Outfits" and "Additional Costumes" DLC below were sometimes not applied within game despite having entered the appropriate codes.
・Eren & Levi Plain clothes Outfit Early Release 
・Mikasa & Armin Plain clothes Outfit Early Release
・SEASON PASS: Additional Costumes: 20-Piece Set
